rationale: The stock has already gapped up ~12.7% on strong earnings and is now consolidating mid-range (~64% of today's range) with price below VWAP ($87.71) and below the 9-EMA ($87.58), showing slight downward drift in the last few 1-minute candles. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.74%, VIXY +11.35%), which creates headwinds for further upside momentum on a post-earnings gap. With the stock already extended and no clear directional setup — neither a clean pullback-to-support long nor a confirmed breakdown short — the risk/reward is insufficient to justify entry at this moment.
